articles.title: Approach African GP with humility, says Hamilton
articles.description: Lewis Hamilton addresses concerns on human rights grounds about holding an African Grand Prix in Rwanda by saying people should "approach it with humility".

articles.title: Austin track bumps out of control - Verstappen
articles.description: Max Verstappen says the bumps on the track that hosts this weekend's United States Grand Prix are "unacceptable" and "out of control".

articles.description: Could Antonelli be crowned champion? Rosanna and the team look ahead to the US Grand Prix

articles.title: Antonelli to 'just have fun' as he aims for title
articles.description: Kimi Antonelli says he intends to "just have fun" at the United States Grand Prix as he stands on the brink of the Formula 1 World Championship.

articles.title: Briton Slater, 18, to make practice debut in Mexico
articles.description: Briton Freddie Slater will drive for Audi in first practice at the Mexico City and Sao Paulo Grands Prix.
